offering_description.value: Provides uniforms, protective workwear, safety equipment, first aid supplies, and facility services to businesses and municipalities. Its managed uniform rental programs include fitting, pickup, laundering, repair, replacement, and delivery, and its facility programs keep workplaces stocked with supplies.

quotes.quote: At UniFirst, we always deliver because you always deliver. We provide uniforms, workwear, safety clothing, PPE, first aid supplies, and facility services to meet your needs

UniFirst simplifies the uniform rental process by managing everything for you. We start by helping you select uniforms suited to your business and industry. Once chosen, we size your employees to ensure a perfectly fitted uniform. Our service includes weekly pickups of soiled garments, professional laundering, and timely delivery of fresh, clean uniforms. Repairs and replacements are handled seamlessly, reducing your workload so you can focus on more important business.
